skills.title: Distinguish hazard, risk and uncertainty
skills.description: Separate hazard, risk, uncertainty and ambiguity before assessing a case.

skills.title: Communicate under uncertainty
skills.description: State what is known, what remains uncertain, what people should do and when new information will come.

skills.title: Identify an emerging issue
skills.description: Identify who makes a matter relevant, what supports the claim and what the organisation may need to clarify or change.

skills.title: Analyse competing frames
skills.description: Identify how language, images and sources define causes, responsibility, consequences and possible responses.

skills.title: Challenge blind spots with SOFT
skills.description: Test whether social conditions, expectations, framing, transparency or organisational capacity are missing from the first analysis.

skills.title: Move from analysis to organisational response
skills.description: Identify necessary changes in policy, roles, resources, routines or coordination before treating communication as the solution.

skills.title: Write an initial crisis update
skills.description: Combine verified information, explicit uncertainty, practical advice, responsibility and a time for the next update.

skills.title: Write a bounded academic analysis
skills.description: Move from claim to evidence, explanation and interpretation without drawing conclusions beyond the material.

knowledge.title: Issue
knowledge.description: A matter becomes an issue when an actor makes conduct, consequences, values or responsibility relevant.

knowledge.title: Problem
knowledge.description: A documented condition or expectation gap that requires investigation, clarification or change.

knowledge.title: Risk
knowledge.description: Possible future consequences considered together with uncertainty, exposure, vulnerability and values.

knowledge.title: Uncertainty
knowledge.description: Limits to knowledge about probability, consequences, causal relations or future development.

knowledge.title: Crisis
knowledge.description: A situation that threatens valued outcomes, compresses decision time and challenges ordinary organisational capacity.

knowledge.title: Public
knowledge.description: A group that forms around a recognised consequence, shared concern or contested value.

knowledge.title: Framing
knowledge.description: Selection and organisation of elements into an interpretation of problems, causes, evaluations and possible responses.

knowledge.title: Media distortion
knowledge.description: Presentational operations such as sharpening, simplification, polarisation, intensification, concretisation and personification.

knowledge.title: PRK
knowledge.description: An analytical model for conditional movement among problem, risk and crisis.

knowledge.title: SOFT
knowledge.description: A reflexive lens for testing social and organisational assumptions and blind spots.

knowledge.title: FIVER
knowledge.description: A five-stage framework for understanding, identifying, evaluating, changing and responding.
